# ManifestDelivery

`schemas/records/manifest-delivery.json`

The second ContextManifest event (docs/design/m0/10), appended once per turn as the adapter streams. It evidences that turn: the controller-mediated tool results with the exact handles the core supplied, the adapter's coverage declarations, and compaction marks. Every delivered ref passed the restriction check again before it was supplied (KA1).

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `manifest` | yes | [ManifestID](common-defs.md#manifestid) |  |
| `turn` | yes | integer (minimum `1`, maximum `1000000`) | 1 for the first turn. |
| `tool_results` | yes | array of object ([fields](#fields-of-tool_results)) |  |
| `declarations` | yes | array of string (minLength `1`) | What the adapter says it delivered in this turn. Never evidence: each one is declared-only in the finalized coverage. |
| `compacted` | yes | boolean | The harness compacted its context in this turn. |

No other fields are allowed.

## Fields of tool_results[]

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `handle` | yes | string (minLength `1`) | The handle the core supplied for this result. |
| `ref` | yes | [ref](records-ref.md) | A declared input of the intent, or a ref derived only from declared inputs: its lineage is non-empty and names only declared input ids, and it keeps every restriction of every declared input each lineage id names (several inputs may share an id). |

No other fields are allowed.
